Per unit, apply the first matching rule:
1) Exact required-cell / required-effect commit: If the scenario intent or this turn’s goal names a specific finish, end, target, or hit cell, choose the lowest-index legal option whose actual resolution exactly reaches or covers that cell. 3) Lethal / damage: Otherwise choose a legal attack that kills; else highest immediate damage against the highest-threat enemy.
4) Pressure/contact: Otherwise choose the most aggressive legal move/fast_move that most reduces distance to key enemies/objectives and creates next-turn contact. Do not retreat unless every forward option is strictly worse by rule 5.
